text:
maria: Heads up - planning a staged provider + IAM cutover in staging tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC. We'll serially apply per-AZ, canary in us-west-2a then roll to 2b/2c. Deploybot will manage handoffs. Tagging @dmitri and @jon for canary checks.

deploy-bot: scheduled apply window created: 2024-03-15 23:00 UTC -> 2024-03-16 00:30 UTC. Canary policy: 5m health check, auto-hold on >0.5% error.

dmitri: +1. One ask: pin aws provider to 1.4.3 for this run. 1.4.4 has a bad egress-change race we saw in canary yesterday. I'll update the module; prefer explicit provider_pin var.

jon: For staging canary I'm going to apply only the networking + iam modules first. I'll use a targeted plan to validate outputs:
```
terraform plan -target=module.networking -target=module.iam -out=canary.plan
terraform apply canary.plan
```

maria: prefer not to rely on -target for prod flows, but for staging canary this is fine. Important: enable traffic-shadowing for the canary so we don't cut real traffic until health is green. Add note in release notes.

infra-oncall: Rollback plan documented: if request error rate >1% sustained for 10m OR latency p50 > 250ms for 5m, abort remaining applies and revert to git sha f2b4a9c (previous deployment). Revert steps included below:
```
git revert --no-edit f2b4a9c..HEAD
git push origin release-cutover
# then deploy-bot will pick and run terraform apply from previous plan artifact
```

dmitri: I'm going to push provider_pin="1.4.3" to the release branch now and attach the pinned lockfile to the release notes. @deploy-bot make sure the apply uses the release branch.

deploy-bot: noted. Will only start apply when branch is green and release notes are attached. Canary job will run in us-west-2a, health checks enabled.

sre-bot: canary run started at 23:05 UTC in us-west-2a. Monitoring: egress error 0.2% so far.

maria: thanks - @jon keep an eye on the IAM entitlements logs (authz failures). If we see >5 authz failures/min, pause and report.

sre-bot: at 23:12 UTC - egress error spike to 2.1% over 3m, p90 latency up 60ms. Marking canary: failing.

jon: holding rollouts. Do NOT apply to 2b/2c. Investigating; initial suspicion is provider 1.4.4 drift.

dmitri: that's what I feared. Can we abort remaining applies and trigger the documented rollback?

maria: Abort confirmed. @deploy-bot, stop further apply. Begin rollback to f2b4a9c. Post once completed.

deploy-bot: aborting remaining steps, starting rollback sequence now. Will run:
```
# apply previous plan artifact
deploy-bot run apply --artifact previous-plan-20240315
```

deploy-bot: rollback apply completed at 23:22 UTC. All modules reported as successful and state restored to previous version.

infra-oncall: Verified: traffic metrics back to baseline by 23:28 UTC. Logging a follow-up action: reproduce egress race locally with provider 1.4.4 and submit bug.

maria: Good response. Next actions: add provider_pin=1.4.3 to the release notes and keep branch blocked until provider fix. We'll also schedule a deeper probe test in staging tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

dmitri: I'll open the issue and link the canary traces.

jon: Leaving a short blurb for release notes: "Staged cutover aborted - provider 1.4.4 caused egress instability; rolled back to 1.4.3. Investigating."

maria: adding to release notes and bumping change window hold. Will update on slack when we have a repro.

sre-bot: note saved to incident log ID INC-20240315-09.

maria: end.
